records.title: Xetrieval: Mechanistically Explaining Dense Retrieval
records.reason: Mechanistic explanation of dense retrieval, without a concrete inference efficiency method.

records.title: AMDP: Asynchronous Multi-Directional Pipeline Parallelism for Large-Scale Models Training
records.reason: Asynchronous multidirectional pipeline parallelism targets large-scale model training throughput/stragglers, not inference serving. Related distributed-training lineage exists, but direct inference transfer is not demonstrated.

records.title: Leveraging Routing Dynamics in Mixture-of-Experts Models for Efficient Language Adaptation
records.reason: Routing-aware MoE method improves multilingual adaptation/finetuning; evaluation focuses on translation quality and adaptation rather than serving cost or inference throughput.

records.title: Faithful Embeddings of Irregular and Asynchronous Data for Online Log-NCDEs
records.reason: Irregular-data time-series embedding method, outside LLM inference.

records.title: Loong: A Human-Like Long Document Translation Agent with Observe-and-Act Adaptive Context Selection
records.reason: Loong uses a 3E summary/exemplar/entity memory and observe-and-act retrieval to choose translation context, improving context utilization for long documents. However, it adds reasoning overhead and is evaluated for translation quality, not latency/memory savings.
